title: Utsukushii sube
overview: Amemiya, an unemployed man who is constantly involved in extramarital affairs, and Ota, a civil servant who is perpetually being reprimanded at work, lead very different lives. One day, Amemiya meets Moritani, a coworker of Ota's. Amemiya finds himself drawn to Moritani, but Moritani's interest lies with Ota. Takamasa Oe's directorial debut feature.
